# Average Change in hourly prices

## 1.) Preparation

### 1.1) laod packages and data

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(broom)
library(reshape2)
```

```{r}
Data_BA <- read_excel("Data_BA.xlsx")
head(Data_BA)
```

### 1.2) Analysis of dataset and adjustments
```{r}
# Checking for NA's
colSums(is.na(Data_BA))
```
```{r}
# Checking Class of Data
sapply(Data_BA,class)
```
Day ahead is declared as character because negative values have a "," as delimiter istead of "."
This needs to be changed

```{r}
#Substituting "," with "."
Data_BA$Day_ahead <- gsub(",", ".", Data_BA$Day_ahead)
Data_BA$Day_ahead <- as.numeric(Data_BA$Day_ahead)
```

Further adjustments so that the date has the correct format. Year, month and hours columns are also added.

```{r}
Data_BA$Date_from <- as.POSIXct(Data_BA$Date_from, format="%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", tz="UTC")
Data_BA$Date_to <- as.POSIXct(Data_BA$Date_to, format="%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", tz="UTC")

Data_BA$date <- as.Date(Data_BA$Date_from)
Data_BA$hour <- hour(Data_BA$Date_from)
Data_BA$year <- format(Data_BA$Date_from, "%Y")
Data_BA$Month <- factor(Data_BA$Month, levels = 1:12, labels = c(
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", 
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"))
```

In our analysis we use the lagged gas price, so we need to adjust this as well.

```{r}
Data_BA$lagged_Gas_Price <- c(rep(NA, 24), Data_BA$Gas_Price[1:(nrow(Data_BA) - 24)])
```

```{r}
Df <- Data_BA[-(1:24),]
```

Finally, we need to create daily aggregates of solar and wind generation in GWh.

```{r}
daily_totals <- Df %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(total_daily_solar = sum(PH, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
            total_daily_wind = sum(Wind_Total, na.rm = TRUE)/1000)


Df2 <- merge(Df, daily_totals, by = "date")
head(Df2)
```

## 2.) Estimation

```{r}
results_Wind <- list()

for (h in 0:23) {
  # Filter data for the specific hour
  Df_hourly <- Df2 %>% filter(hour == h)
  
  # Regression
  formula <- Day_ahead ~ total_daily_solar + total_daily_wind + lagged_Gas_Price + Lignite + Load + Month
  
  # Fit the model
  model <- lm(formula, data = Df_hourly)
  
  
  results_Wind[[h + 1]] <- tidy(model) %>% filter(term == c("total_daily_wind")) %>% select(estimate, std.error) %>%
    mutate(estimate = estimate , std.error = std.error)
}


results_df_Wind <- do.call(rbind, results_Wind)
results_df_Wind$hour <- 0:23

# Confidence intervals
results_df_Wind <- results_df_Wind %>%
  mutate(
    conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# Plotting
M_Wind <- ggplot(results_df_Wind, aes(x = hour, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Day Ahead Price per GWh of Daily Wind",
    x = "Hour",
    y = "Change in Avg. Hourly Price (€/MWh)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

# Solar

for (h in 0:23) {

  results_Solar[[h + 1]] <- tidy(model) %>% filter(term == c("total_daily_solar")) %>% select(estimate, std.error) %>%
    mutate(estimate = estimate, std.error = std.error)
}


results_df_Solar <- do.call(rbind, results_Solar)
results_df_Solar$hour <- 0:23

# Confidence intervals
results_df_Solar <- results_df_Solar %>%
  mutate(
    conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

# Plotting
M_Solar <- ggplot(results_df_Solar, aes(x = hour, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.2) +

    title = "Change in Day Ahead Price per GWh of daily solar",

for (h in 0:23) {
```

# Substitution pattern between renewables and non-renewables

## 1.) Preparation

### 1.1) load data

```{r, results= "hide"}
Net_imports <- read_excel("Net_Imports.xlsx")
Production <- read_excel("Production.xlsx",skip = 8)
```
### 1.2) Analysis of dataset and adjustments

```{r}
# First we look for any NA's
colSums(is.na(Production))
```

```{r}
# Checking class of Data
sapply(Production,class)
```

```{r}
# usual adjustments
Production$Date_from <- as.POSIXct(Production$Date_from, format="%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", tz="UTC")
Production$Date_to <- as.POSIXct(Production$Date_to, format="%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", tz="UTC")

# adding columns
Production$date <- as.Date(Production$Date_from)
Production$hour <- hour(Production$Date_from)
Production$year <- format(Production$Date_from, "%Y")
Production$Month <- factor(Production$Month, levels = 1:12, labels = c(
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", 
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"))

# Here we add the net import data
Production$Net_Import <- as.numeric(Net_imports$Net_Imports)
```

```{r}
# And again, we need to add the daily aggregates
Df3 <- merge(Production, daily_totals, by = "date")
```

```{r}
# This is the final dataset
head(Df3)
```
### 2.) Estimation

```{r}
run_hourly_regressions <- function(data) {
  results <- list()
  
  for (h in 0:23) {
    # Filter data for the specific hour
    Df_hourly <- data %>% filter(hour == h)
    
    # Define the models for each energy source
    models <- list()
    models$Nuclear <- lm(Nuclear ~ total_daily_solar + total_daily_wind + Thermal + other + Nuc1 + Nuc2 + Nuc3 + COVID + Month, data = Df_hourly)
    
    models$other <- lm(other ~ total_daily_solar + total_daily_wind + Nuclear + Thermal + COVID + Month, data = Df_hourly)
    
    models$Thermal <- lm(Thermal ~ total_daily_solar + total_daily_wind + Nuclear + other + COVID + Lignite1 + Lignite2 + Lignite3 + Lignite4 + Lignite5 + Lignite6 + Coal1 + Coal2 + Coal3 +  Month , data = Df_hourly)
    
    models$Net_Import <- lm(Net_Import ~ total_daily_solar + total_daily_wind + Thermal + other + Nuclear + COVID + Month, data = Df_hourly)
    
    results[[paste0("hour_", h)]] <- lapply(models, summary)
  }
  
  return(results)
}

hourly_results <- run_hourly_regressions(Df3)

# Here we define function to extract coefficients for plotting
extract_coefficients <- function(results, variable) {
  data <- data.frame(
    Hour = 0:23,
    Nuclear = sapply(0:23, function(h) coef(results[[paste0("hour_", h)]]$Nuclear)[variable, "Estimate"]),
    other = sapply(0:23, function(h) coef(results[[paste0("hour_", h)]]$other)[variable, "Estimate"]),
    Thermal = sapply(0:23, function(h) coef(results[[paste0("hour_", h)]]$Thermal)[variable, "Estimate"]),
    Net_Imp = sapply(0:23, function(h) coef(results[[paste0("hour_", h)]]$Net_Import)[variable, "Estimate"])
  )
  return(data)
}

# 
solar_coeffs <- extract_coefficients(hourly_results, "total_daily_solar")
wind_coeffs <- extract_coefficients(hourly_results, "total_daily_wind")

```

```{r}
# Plotting
plot_coefficients <- function(coeffs, title) {
  ggplot(coeffs, aes(x = Hour)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Nuclear, color = "Nuclear")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Thermal, color = "Thermal")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = other, color = "Other")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Net_Imp, color = "Net Imports")) +
    labs(title = title, y = "Avg. Change in Hourly Generation (MWh)", x = "Hour", color = "Source:") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Nuclear" = "green", "Other" = "brown", "Thermal" = "blue", "Net Imports" = "black")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
}

# Plot for Solar
plot_solar <- plot_coefficients(solar_coeffs, "Change in Output by Source per GWh of Daily Solar")

# Plot for Wind
plot_wind <- plot_coefficients(wind_coeffs, "Change in Output by Source per GWh of Daily Wind")
```

```{r}
print(plot_solar)
```

```{r}
print(plot_wind)
```
Here we check for the sums of the coefficients. 1 GWh increase in solar/wind output should decrease sum of the output from all other sources to the same amount:
```{r}
sum_hourly_changes <- function(coeffs) {
  coeffs %>%
    summarise(
      Nuclear = sum(Nuclear),
      Thermal = sum(Thermal),
      other = sum(other),
      Net_Imp = sum(Net_Imp),
    )
}

# Summing the changes for solar
solar_sums <- sum_hourly_changes(solar_coeffs)

# Summing the changes for wind
wind_sums <- sum_hourly_changes(wind_coeffs)
```

```{r}
# For solar
sum(solar_sums)
```

```{r}
# For wind
sum(wind_sums)
```

# Plots

### Figure 3

```{r}
start_date <- as.Date("2018-10-02")
end_date <- as.Date("2024-02-29")
filtered_data <- Df2 %>%
  filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date)

# Plot the data
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = filtered_data, aes(x = date, y = total_daily_wind, color = "Daily Wind"), shape = 1) +
  geom_point(data = filtered_data, aes(x = date, y = total_daily_solar, color = "Daily Solar"), shape = 17) +
  labs(title = "Daily Solar and Wind Generation (October 2018 - February 2024)",
       x = "Date", y = "Daily Generation (GWh)",color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Daily Solar" = "red", "Daily Wind" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), 
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5,face = "bold") 
  )
```

### Figure 4

```{r}
data_2019_2023 <- Df %>% filter(year %in% c("2019", "2023"))

# Average hourly load for 2019 and 2023
average_hourly_load <- data_2019_2023 %>%
  group_by(year, hour) %>%
  summarise(avg_load = mean(Load))

ggplot(average_hourly_load, aes(x = as.numeric(hour), y = avg_load, color = year, group = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title="Average Hourly Load", x="Hour", y="Load (MW)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Average hourly solar generation for 2019 and 2023
average_hourly_solar <- data_2019_2023 %>%
  group_by(year, hour) %>%
  summarise(avg_solar = mean(PH, na.rm=TRUE))

ggplot(average_hourly_solar, aes(x = as.numeric(hour), y = avg_solar, color = year, group = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title="Average Hourly Solar Generation", x="Hour", y="Solar Generation (MWh)") +

  group_by(year, hour) %>%
  summarise(avg_price = mean(Day_ahead))

ggplot(average_hourly_day_ahead, aes(x = as.numeric(hour), y = avg_price, color = year, group = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title="Average Hourly Day ahead price", x="Hour", y="Price (€/MWh)") +

  group_by(year, hour) %>%
  summarise(avg_wind = mean(Wind_Total))


ggplot(average_hourly_wind, aes(x = as.numeric(hour), y = avg_wind, color = year, group = year)) +

# Plots
```

### Figure 5

```{r}
# Aggregate data to yearly totals
yearly_data <- Production %>% 
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Biomass, Hydropower, `Wind Total`, PV, `Natural gas`, Nuclear, Lignite, Coal), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6))
yearly_data <-yearly_data[-c(1,7),]

melted_data <- melt(yearly_data, id.vars = "year")

ggplot(melted_data, aes(x = year, y = value, color = variable, group = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Yearly Energy Production in Terawatt-hours (TWh)",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Energy Production (TWh)",
       color = "Energy Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )
```
